prompts.prompt: An architectural masterpiece photograph of an ultra-modern commercial solar carport in Phuket, Thailand (7.88°N, 98.38°E). Sleek black bifacial photovoltaic panels on a minimalist dark galvanized steel frame. Late-afternoon tropical sun positioned low at 16.45° elevation / 292.2° azimuth (June solstice, true NOAA sun position for this latitude), casting long soft shadows toward the west-southwest across polished wet asphalt. Golden hour color temperature, lush tropical foliage contrasting with clean engineering lines, EV charging bays with subtle cyan LED status lights. Shot on medium-format camera, 35mm lens, f/8, photorealistic, editorial architecture magazine style. Palette: obsidian structure, solar amber highlights, restrained cyan accents. --no cartoon, text, watermark, oversaturated colors, fantasy elements.

prompts.prompt: A clean-tech holographic data visualization: a 3D map of Thailand built from 77 glowing vertical columns, one per province, placed at each province's real latitude and longitude. Column height and color encode specific solar yield in kWh/kWp/year: the tallest column glows solar amber at Phuket in the south (1510.98 kWh/kWp/yr), the shortest glows dimmer cyan-blue at Trat near the eastern border (1286.82 kWh/kWp/yr), with a national mean of 1373.51. Matte black environment, thin grid floor, subtle data callouts in Thai typography, cinematic volumetric lighting, depth of field on the tallest column. Matches the visual language of an existing WebGL yield infographic. --no fantasy weapons, clutter, unreadable numbers, watermark.

prompts.prompt: Isometric 3D exploded engineering render of a heavy-duty commercial solar carport system. Floating layers from bottom to top: concrete foundation piles, galvanized C-channel steel columns in warm stone gray, waterproof gutter channel, tilted monocrystalline panel array on a shallow rake with micro-inverters and cable trays. Clean studio lighting on a neutral dark slate background, CAD precision, subtle metallic reflections, Dieter Rams inspired industrial design restraint. Palette: obsidian, stone gray steel, one amber accent line. --no cartoon, text, watermark, clutter.
